title: Trucker Hat Pop Up Experience in Charleston
includes: Pay on site - hats, patches, buttons, and pins (not included)
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
All areas and surfaces are wheelchair accessible
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Host a Mobile Cart Bash with Mess Hall Charleston and bring a unique, interactive experience to your party, wedding, or special celebration.
Our mobile cart allows guests to create custom hats featuring patches and pins that match your event’s theme, making for a fun and memorable keepsake. Choose from four exciting themes: Casino Bach, a Vegas-style glam experience; Mess Hall, a bold, cafeteria-inspired collection of patches; Beach Bash, perfect for a sunny, coastal celebration; or Pink Cowgirl, a western-inspired theme for the wild at heart. We provide a two-hour service window with a fully stocked mobile cart and a dedicated staff member to assist guests in designing their one-of-a-kind hats. Our team takes care of setup and breakdown, allowing you to focus on enjoying the event. Let us bring the creativity, fun, and a personalized touch to your Charleston celebration! 

*When booking please include the event head count*
